app.name: TapAlong
app.tagline: a gentle tap alongside your reading
app.privacy: Your notes are sent to a cloud-based teacher to generate responses.
app.settingsPanel: Settings only change the interface language. The teacher always follows the language of your message.

newPage.title: New page
newPage.placeholder: Jot a line as you read…
newPage.emptyError: Write a line before keeping this page.

overlay.failed: That line didn't make it in.

teacherFallback.suggestCloseAfterSave: I've read this page. Alongside what you've written before, there's nothing to talk about right now. Keep reading, or close this page.
teacherFallback.suggestCloseInTalk: Nothing more to ask for now. If you're ready, close this page.
teacherFallback.suggestCloseAfterMaintain: Your note is updated. I looked — nothing to discuss this round. You decide whether to close.
teacherFallback.userClosed: Alright, we'll stop here for this page.
teacherFallback.firstQuestion: When you wrote "{keyword}", what did you mean? Could you say a bit more?
teacherFallback.followUp: If that's what you mean, who decides "{keyword}"? Is it {optionA}, or {optionB}?
teacherFallback.attentionAllocation: After that allocation, where does the remaining attention go?
teacherFallback.counterExample: You said "{keyword}" — can you think of a counterexample?
teacherFallback.afterAppend: You've added that thought. So then, {question}?
teacherFallback.afterEdit: Clearer now. But the mechanism of "{keyword}" — could you say more?
teacherFallback.activeOrDriven: is the allocation active, or driven by the task
teacherFallback.resumeWithContext: In "{contextTitle}", you wrote about "{contextKeyword}". How does that connect with "{targetKeyword}" on this page?

errors.pageNotFound: This page could not be found.
errors.invalidListLimit: The page list options are invalid.
errors.teacherInvalidRequest: That question is invalid. Please try writing it again.
errors.teacherPageNotFound: The page being discussed could not be found.
errors.pageClosed: This page is closed and can no longer be updated.
errors.secureStorageUnavailable: This system cannot securely store the API key. Use a system with secure credential storage.
errors.invalidBaseUrl: The base URL must use HTTPS. Local services may use http://localhost.
errors.configFailed: The model configuration could not be saved. Try again.
errors.providerNotConfigured: Save an API key for this provider first.
errors.providerUnauthorized: The API key is invalid or lacks permission.
errors.modelUnavailable: The model ID is unavailable. Check the provider configuration.
errors.providerRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.providerNetworkError: Could not reach the model service. Check the network and base URL.
errors.providerTimeout: The model service timed out. Try again.
errors.providerRequestFailed: The model service could not complete this request. Check the provider settings or try again.
errors.teacherNoResponse: The teacher didn't respond. Try again?
errors.stackTooDeep: The stack is getting deep. Close one page before continuing?
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.conversationDataHint: Manage pages and conversations stored on this device.
settings.clearConversationsDescription: Delete every page, conversation, and closed page. Model providers and API keys are kept.
settings.clearConversationsWarning: This cannot be undone. All pages and conversations will be removed from this device. Provider settings will remain.
settings.privacyText: Your notes are sent to a cloud-based teacher to generate responses.
settings.modelServiceHint: Choose a provider and configure your own API key.
settings.providerNamePlaceholder: For example, Qwen, Moonshot, or a local service
settings.apiKeyConfigured: Encrypted and saved. Enter a new key to replace it.
settings.keySecurityHint: The API key is encrypted by the main process and never returned to the interface.
settings.keyCleared: The API key for this provider was cleared.
settings.providerActivated: The active model provider was changed.
